# From rrule-go, rrule_test.go at commit e74d163 (github.com/teambition/rrule-go),
# converted to libical's vector format: each test's options as an RRULE, its
# expected times as INSTANCES. Tests of the Go API rather than of a rule
# are left out.
# Copyright (c) 2017-2023 Teambition. SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# The tests are ported from python-dateutil's test_rrule.py:
# Copyright 2017- Paul Ganssle and dateutil contributors.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause

# TestByNegativeMonthDay
RRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;COUNT=3;BYMONTHDAY=-1
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970930T090000Z,19971031T090000Z,19971130T090000Z

# TestWeeklyMaxYear
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYMONTHDAY=31;BYYEARDAY=1
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:

# TestHourlyInvalidAndRepeatedBysetpos
RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY;UNTIL=19970902T110000Z;BYSETPOS=1,-1,2
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,19970902T100000Z,19970902T110000Z

# TestYearly
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,19980902T090000Z,19990902T090000Z

# TestYearlyInterval
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;INTERVAL=2;COUNT=3
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,19990902T090000Z,20010902T090000Z

# TestYearlyIntervalLarge
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;INTERVAL=100;COUNT=3
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,20970902T090000Z,21970902T090000Z

# TestYearlyByMonth
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3;BYMONTH=1,3
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19980102T090000Z,19980302T090000Z,19990102T090000Z

# TestYearlyByMonthDay
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3;BYMONTHDAY=1,3
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970903T090000Z,19971001T090000Z,19971003T090000Z

# TestYearlyByMonthAndMonthDay
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3;BYMONTH=1,3;BYMONTHDAY=5,7
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19980105T090000Z,19980107T090000Z,19980305T090000Z

# TestYearlyByWeekDay
RRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=3;BYDAY=TU,TH
DTSTART:19970902T090000Z
INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,19970904T090000Z,19970909T090000Z

INSTANCES:19970902T090000Z,19970903T100101Z,19970904T110202Z

# TestSecondlyByMonth

INSTANCES:19980101T000000Z,19980101T000001Z,19980101T000002Z
